## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear description of what the problem is. E.g. "I always have to manually re-enter the same problem setup..."

## Describe the Solution You'd Like
What you want to happen. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've thought about.

## Which part of the project does this affect?
- [ ] Frontend (canvas, chat UI, pages)
- [ ] Backend (API, AI logic, auth)
- [ ] AI evaluation / hints
- [ ] Preset problems / reference designs
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional Context
Any screenshots, mockups, or references that might help.
